driver: The test executable itself: Test_LinearSolvers_ABecLaplacian_C_3d inputs-node n_cell=16 max_grid_size=8 (prob_type = 4: nodal ABecLaplacian, MLMG::solve, geometric multigrid, 4 MG levels on one AMR level). Each smoother call is MLNodeABecLaplacian::Fsmooth -> ParallelFor(sol, ...) with mlndlap_adotx_aa + mlndabeclap_jacobi_aa in one launch (the racing kernel); the run converges in 6 V-cycles. Prints the AMReX banner and 'MLMG: Final Iter. 6 resid, resid/resid0 = ..., 1.4e-11'; writes a small plotfile 'solution-lev0_*' into the working directory (the run dir on BeeGFS).
input: n_cell=16 max_grid_size=8 -> 8 boxes of 8^3 cells (9^3 = 729 nodes each, 5832 fine-level nodes), 4 multigrid levels, 6 V-cycles to the test's fixed 1e-10 tolerance. Thread-level accesses estimated at about 1e7 (about 50 global accesses per node per smoother sweep x 4 smoother sweeps and 2 residuals per V-cycle on the fine level x 6 V-cycles, plus the coarse levels; estimate from the stencil, not measured), below the 1e8 hard limit. The coordinator's suggested max_iter=2 is NOT used: with max_iter=2 the test aborts after the 2nd V-cycle ('MLMG: Failed to converge after 2 iterations ... amrex::Abort::0::MLMG failed. !!!', SIGABRT, rc=1; measured in the sm_75 smoke run) because the tolerance (tol_rel 1e-10) is hard-coded in MyTest.cpp; the default max_iter=100 gives rc=0.
notes: Smoke on c38 (sm_75 rebuild via rw.sh smoke, NOT the deliverable): buggy with n_cell=16 max_grid_size=8: rc=0, 6 iterations, wall about 0.6 s (resid/resid0 after iterations 1..6: 3.6e-3, 5.2e-5, 1.2e-6, 2.6e-8, 6.1e-10, 1.4e-11); with max_iter=2 rc=1 (SIGABRT, see above). Fixed variant: rc=0, also 6 iterations (final resid/resid0 3.9e-11), same stdout shape. AMReX preallocates its device arena at startup (about 75 percent of device memory by default, 5839 MB on the 8 GB sm_75 card; amrex.the_arena_init_size=<bytes> on the command line overrides it). sm_89 artifacts: /mnt/beegfs/fzheng4/realworld/build/amrex-1/{buggy,fixed}/{Test_LinearSolvers_ABecLaplacian_C_3d (83 MB, mostly fat device code), inputs-node (copied from the source tree), build_flags.txt, cmake_args.txt}. The racing pair is in the Fsmooth lambda; two instantiations of it exist in the binary (128- and 256-thread launch_global), the reach phase says which is launched; T_KERNEL=MLNodeABecLaplacian7Fsmooth (the mangled-name fragment unique to MLNodeABecLaplacian::Fsmooth; the other Fsmooth kernels in the binary belong to MLPoisson, MLALaplacian, MLABecLaplacian, MLNodeLaplacian and MLNodeTensorLaplacian, which prob_type=4 is not expected to launch). Run from the harness RUNDIR (BeeGFS) so the plotfile is written there. No environment variables needed beyond LD_LIBRARY_PATH for the CUDA toolkit libs. The artifact copy to BeeGFS failed once for amrex-1/fixed (BeeGFS client was reloaded on c38 at about 17:08, see the report); the files were copied by hand from the node-local build dir and the sizes match the buggy ones.
